---
title: "Instacart Shopping Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

data("instacart")
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Products by Department
```{r bar_plot}
instacart |>
  count(department) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head(10) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~department,
    y = ~n,
    type = "bar"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Department", tickangle = -45),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Purchased Items")
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Reorder Rate by Hour
```{r line_plot}
instacart |>
  group_by(order_hour_of_day) |>
  summarize(
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day,
    y = ~reorder_rate,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Hour of Day"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Reordered Items (%)")
  )
```


### Add-to-Cart Position by Department
```{r box_plot}
set.seed(123)

instacart |>
  filter(
    department %in% c("produce", "dairy eggs", "snacks", "beverages")
  ) |>
  group_by(department) |>
  sample_n(500) |>
  ungroup() |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~department,
    y = ~add_to_cart_order,
    type = "box",
    boxpoints = FALSE
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Department"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Add-to-Cart Position")
  )
```
